notes: Reference date 2018-02-26. 2018_04_hr_manual_parental_leave_section_2016 is the same as 2018_03_hr_manual_parental_leave_section_2015 except for 'any full time employee'.

Governing documents: the Faculty Handbook (tenure-clock provisions, Sept 8, 2016 amendment, in force) and the Employee Benefits and Policies Manual, which applies to '(non-union) staff, faculty* and administration' and defers to the Faculty Handbook in conflict. The Faculty Handbook holds no parental, medical or sick leave of its own; its 'Unpaid Leaves' (off-campus professional opportunity, up to 2 years) and sabbatical policy cannot be used for a birth and are not components.

Versions: the manual in force on 2018-02-26 is not archived. Parental leave (c1-c3) is bracketed by the identical Oct 2015 section and Sept 2018 manual (per the document's version note); the 2016 section differs only in 'any full time employee' for the MMLA leave (c3, conflicting_sources). Other manual provisions (FMLA, sick days, disability, vacation, personal leave) are taken from the Sept 2018 manual and checked against the Oct 2014 manual; where they differ (the 2018 FMLA text adds pregnancy incapacity, the 12-week combination statement and the part-time return wording appears in both), the 2018 text is coded and flagged version_uncertain.

Superseded, not coded: the Oct 2014 manual's 'Maternity/Adoption/Parental Leave' (female employees: 100% pay for up to 8 weeks of maternity/adoption leave after the introductory period, non-exempt staff serving the STD elimination period; male employees: up to 8 weeks unpaid MMLA parental leave). The version note and the 2015 section show it replaced before the reference date by the gender-neutral primary/non-primary caregiver policy.

Paid parental leave (c1, c2): 'Any employee' after the introductory period; the introductory period is defined only for staff (3 months non-exempt, 6 months exempt administration), so for faculty its length is not stated. The member with two years of service meets it (U8). Primary versus non-primary caregiver is self-declared by affidavit; caregiver conditions are read as gender-neutral (R6), so c1 counts for both roles and c2 is its alternative. Salary continuation applies only to time the employee would normally work (no paid parental leave in summer for academic-year appointees): flagged ambiguous: restriction. The 'matrix below' referenced in the section is not in any saved text.

Exempt (Salaried) Staff provisions (c6 sick-day salary continuation 26 weeks at 100%, c7 family-care sick days, c10 vacation): the manual does not say in terms that faculty fall under this heading; coded as covering faculty (the manual covers faculty, pays 'Exempt (Salaried) Staff Administrators and Faculty' together, and its 'Exempt (Salaried) Staff' overtime paragraph addresses academic-year appointees), and flagged ambiguous. The FMLA section says pregnancy and childbirth disability is administered under the sick leave policies, so c6 is the birth parent's medical-period pay (generic plan, V1 not met: no childbirth period stated). c6 is pay only, not a leave of absence (U6); the protected medical leave is FMLA (c4).

Leave limit: the Sept 2018 FMLA section says the medical leave period for pregnancy and childbirth plus additional unpaid child-care leave 'should not exceed 12 weeks in total' (leave_limits, birth parent). Requests beyond 12 weeks are reviewed case by case (c5, discretionary, no length).

Pregnancy and lactation accommodation (c15) rests on the Massachusetts Pregnant Workers Fairness Act 'effective on April 1, 2018', after the reference date: flagged not_yet_effective. Doctor's-visit paid time, bereavement, jury duty, domestic violence leave, military leave and the Small Necessities Leave Act cannot be used for a birth and are not components.

Calendar: WPI's academic year is organised in Terms A-D (7-week terms are not stated); no term length or semester/quarter kind is stated, so no calendar is recorded. No component is measured in terms.

Chain, birth parent: primary-caregiver paid parental leave 8 weeks (c1), with FMLA 12 weeks (c4) and the MMLA leave 8 weeks (c3) running concurrently from its start; sick-day salary continuation (c6, generic, up to 26 weeks) concurrent with FMLA during medical incapacity; medical period plus child-care leave capped at 12 weeks (leave_limits); vacation (c10) usable within FMLA; discretionary unpaid extension (c5) and discretionary part-time return (c12) after FMLA. (Alternative: non-primary 2 weeks, c2, in lieu of c1.)

Chain, non-birth parent: primary-caregiver paid parental leave 8 weeks (c1) or, if not the primary caregiver, non-primary 2 weeks (c2, in lieu of c1), with FMLA 12 (c4) and MMLA 8 (c3) concurrent from the start; family-care sick days (c7, 6 days) for an ill spouse; vacation within FMLA (c10); discretionary extension (c5) and part-time return (c12) after FMLA.
